course_name_original: Inclusive Approaches to Education of Students with Special (FMFI.KAI/1-MXX-491/22)
course_name_en: Inclusive Approaches to Education of Students with Special Needs

learning_outcomes.text: They will get acquainted with the basic characteristics of types of health disadvantage (HR) and will know the consequences of HR on education.
Gain personal experience from meetings with people with disabilities and will be able to explain and apply the rules of communication with them.
Can characterize the forms of education of students with SEN and assess the possibilities of their pedagogical, technical and human support, which positively affect the success of education.

syllabus_topics: Human, communication, information and architectural barriers.
Information access technologies for people with disabilities.
Possibilities and limits of creating equal conditions for the education of pupils with specific educational needs.
The importance of education for the social inclusion of people with disabilities.

assessment_methods.method: active participation in class (elaboration of assigned tasks, participation in discussions)

assessment_rules: Continuous assessment is based on active participation in class (elaboration of assigned tasks, participation in discussions). An indicative assessment level is A 90%, B 80%, C 70%, D 60%, E 50%. The scale of assessment is 100/0.
